test_title: PYST 81: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(a) one of the primary obstacles encountered

(b) is the risk of sample contamination

(c) during the analysis of controlled dangerous substance (CDS)

(d) from improper handling and collecting methodologies

(e) proof bloodstain patterns and DNA evidence
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2** i.e. **acebd**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence identifies a specific technical challenge within the field of forensic investigation and substance analysis.
 
• **Part (a) is the first part** as it introduces the primary subject: "one of the primary obstacles encountered".
 
• **Part (c) follows** to provide the context of the struggle: "during the analysis of controlled dangerous substance (CDS)". This connects the "obstacles" to a specific scientific process.
 
• **Part (e) is the third part** as it lists the specific forensic evidence being analyzed alongside CDS: "proof bloodstain patterns and DNA evidence".
 
• **Part (b) follows** as it introduces the linking verb 'is' and defines the obstacle: "is the risk of sample contamination".
 
• **Part (d) is the final part** as it explains the origin or cause of the aforementioned risk: "from improper handling and collecting methodologies".
 
• The correct sequence is **acebd**.

 

**Coherent sentence after rearrangement**:

"One of the primary obstacles encountered during the analysis of controlled dangerous substance (CDS) proof bloodstain patterns and DNA evidence is the risk of sample contamination from improper handling and collecting methodologies."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Structural Breakdown:** The sentence follows a standard **Subject + Qualifier + Verb + Complement** pattern. 

 
 
• **Subject:** One of the primary obstacles (a)
 
• **Qualifier:** encountered during the analysis... (c + e)
 
• **Verb:** is (b)
 
• **Complement:** the risk of sample contamination... (b + d)
 
 
 
• **Forensic Context:** In forensic science, "Controlled Dangerous Substances" (CDS) and "DNA evidence" are highly sensitive to "contamination," making the link between parts (b) and (d) logically essential.
